newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Cosco to sell two bulk carriers.
newsitem.headline: Cosco to sell two bulk carriers.

text.p: Cosco Investment (Singapore) said on Thursday it would sell two 45,500 metric diesel propelled bulk carriers it had ordered from Mitsubishi Corp.
The sale price would be 2.34 billion yen for the vessels plus US$750,000 in each case representing profit, Cosco said in a statement.
The sale to two Panamanian companies would be done by assigning the contract that Cosco subsidiary Cosco (Singapore) Pte Ltd had entered into with Mitsubishi.
It said the subsidiary had now agreed to a memorandum of understanding to sell the vessels to Luhai Maritime and Lihai Martitime of Panama.
Cosco said proceeds of the sale would be put towards the proposed option of Cosco (Singapore) to buy two additional vessels. It said the details were still under negotiation.
The statement said the transaction would not have an impact on net earnings per share or net tangible assets per share of the company in the financial year ending December 31, 1996.
